business_rule: discount_amount must be >= 0 and must not exceed gross_sales
transaction_date must exist and be between 2024-01-01 and 2025-12-31
Every product_id must exist in dim_product
Every customer_id other than UNKNOWN must exist in dim_customer
Every store_id other than UNKNOWN must exist in dim_store
UNKNOWN reference values should be monitored and investigated with the source system.
